name: wdr-pdf-utils
description: WDR PDF Generation Utilities Layer - Provides XML to PDF conversion services for Lambda functions

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run create-package
scripts.create-package: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = 'nodejs/node_modules/wdr-pdf-utils'; fs.mkdirSync(dir, {recursive: true}); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'package.json'), JSON.stringify({name: 'wdr-pdf-utils', version: '1.0.0', main: 'index.js', type: 'commonjs'}, null, 2))"

author: KSL Solutions
